_finding: The Bankr skill speaks to an agent that may act on it. It would do harm the day it called a check it could not make 'listed', let a look-alike's own words into the agent's context, or called a weak resemblance a look-alike. These mutations put each back.

mutations.name: a failed check reads as listed
mutations.expect: FAIL a body that is not a verdict is UNAVAILABLE, never listed

mutations.name: the look-alike's own symbol is printed
mutations.find: and it imitates ${SYMBOL.test(String(imp.imitates_symbol ?? '')) ? imp.imitates_symbol : "the issuer's naming"}.`]
mutations.replace: and it imitates ${SYMBOL.test(String(imp.imitates_symbol ?? '')) ? imp.imitates_symbol : "the issuer's naming"}. It calls itself ${b.symbol}.`]
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and the token's own words never reach the output

mutations.name: any resemblance is a look-alike
mutations.expect: FAIL a weak resemblance is not called a look-alike
